clause: Generative/cloud adapter-lane posture: opt-in, degrade-to-native, sandbox-gated, attributable [STU-RAS-044,STU-RAS-045,STU-RAS-046]

scope.summary: Enforce the local-first posture (STU-RAS-044): every ML/AI raster primitive already has a native on-device baseline (MT-035/044/049/052). Register the optional StudioModelAdapter lanes for the STU-RAS-045 source-suite generative features (generative fill/expand, cloud neural/generative filters, vendor generative image service, cloud distraction removal, cloud asset libraries, cloud documents/history, share-for-review) as opt-in adapters — each MUST route through the sandbox->validation->PromotionGate lifecycle like any model-authored mutation (STU-RAS-046), be attributable via KernelActor, and degrade to the native on-device primitive (or a clear 'adapter unavailable' state) when the provider is absent, never blocking or breaking a core raster workflow. No adapter is a runtime dependency; no vendor name becomes a Studio brand/panel.
acceptance_criteria: Generative/cloud features are opt-in adapters, never core dependencies
expected_tests: live: with a generative adapter absent, a generative-fill request degrades to the native content-aware fill (or a clear 'adapter unavailable' state) and the core workflow still completes
live: an adapter-authored mutation routes through sandbox->validation->PromotionGate and is attributed via KernelActor in the audit log
test: no core raster primitive imports/depends on an adapter; no vendor name appears as a Studio brand/panel

spec_clauses.spec_clause_text: **[STU-RAS-044]** Studio's raster domain is local-first: every raster primitive named in 14.4 — including the ML-backed ones (object select, subject select, sky select, sky replacement, inpaint/remove, content-aware fill/scale, HDR merge, noise/stack reduction, denoise, upscale) — MUST have a native, on-device implementation in `studio-engine` that runs offline with no account, sign-in, or cloud call, per [STU-OVR-002]. On-device inference is a core Studio capability, not a provider dependency.

**[STU-RAS-045]** Cloud-, account-, or vendor-generative features are NOT core Studio features. They are recorded here as normative rows and MUST be either an optional `StudioModelAdapter` lane (14.14) or intentionally omitted; none may become a runtime dependency of any core raster primitive. *Derivation: contract table carried into this clause's own microtask as acceptance criteria; yields no microtask of its own.* | Source-suite feature (provenance) | Studio posture | |---|---| | Text-prompted generative fill / generative expand | Optional adapter lane over a pluggable local or remote generative backend; the native content-aware fill/inpaint primitive ([STU-RAS-143]) is the non-optional baseline. | | Cloud "neural"/generative filter items requiring a vendor cloud | Adapter lane per filter where a local model exists; otherwise intentionally omitted. On-device filters branded "neural" upstream ship as native `StudioLiveFilter`/adjustments. | | Vendor generative image service | Adapter lane only; never a dependency; never a Studio brand or panel name. | | Cloud-backed distraction/object removal | Adapter acceleration only; the on-device inpaint/remove primitive is the baseline. | | Vendor cloud asset libraries | Replaced by native local `placed_asset` links and the Handshake asset library; vendor-cloud sync is an optional adapter. | | Vendor cloud documents and cloud version history | Replaced by native local `StudioDocument` history/undo (14.19); vendor cloud storage is omitted. Collaboration is native CRDT (14.16/14.17). | | Vendor share-for-review / cloud project spaces | Replaced by native Studio collaboration/review surfaces; vendor cloud is omitted. |

**[STU-RAS-046]** Any adapter lane MUST be opt-in, MUST route through the sandbox → validation → PromotionGate lifecycle ([STU-RAS-003]), MUST be attributable in the audit log via `KernelActor`, and MUST degrade to the native on-device primitive (or a clear "adapter unavailable" state) when the provider is absent — it MUST NOT block or break any core raster workflow.

implementation_notes.naming: Vendor product names are provenance only. Studio ships Handshake-native names per [STU-SECTION-003].
implementation_notes.database: SurrealDB with the EventLedger is the only durable authority. SQLite, libSQL, Turso and PostgreSQL are forbidden, including in tests and dev caches.
implementation_notes.engine_split: GPU, WGSL and compute live in the studio-engine crate behind its traits. handshake_core must never gain a GPU dependency.
implementation_notes.routing: Navigation extends the existing address and bus seams. No new router.
implementation_notes.worktree: Code paths resolve against the WP-KERNEL-012 worktree, never main.

validator_focus: Confirm every acceptance row traces to a sentence in the cited spec clause carried in implementation_notes. A row with no spec basis is a fabrication.
Reject any row still carrying proof_target_status REQUIRED: it has no proof of its own.
Reject scaffold-only proof: at least one proof command must drive the executable runtime rather than a fixture the implementer authored.
Where the contract touches numeric parameters, confirm hard and soft bounds are stored as separate values and an unknown bound is stored as unknown, never mirrored.
